newsitem.title: USA: Wolverine World Wide Q4 sales help net rise.
newsitem.headline: Wolverine World Wide Q4 sales help net rise.

text.p: Wolverine World Wide Inc said Thursday a record increase in sales helped earnings climb in the fourth quarter ended December 28.

The company reported net income of $16.7 million, or $0.58 a share, compared to $12.5 million, or $0.48 a share one year ago. Sales in the period climbed to $212.6 million from $150.9 million in the corresponding quarter in 1995.
Wolverine World Wide cited revenue gains for its Caterpillar, Hush Puppies shoe brands and its Bates Uniform Group for contributing to the sales increases.
The company makes and markets several brands of footwear and performance leathers.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Thursday at 30-1/2.
